messages:
maria: Quick fyi — I'm going to land an RBAC tightening for the gpu-pool namespace tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Goal: least-priv for deploy SAs + block any cluster-admin scoping from CI bots.
ajay: Ack. Do we have KMS unwrap permissions sorted for the deploy SA? our rollout uses wrapped tokens for ephemeral creds.
maria: Not fully — saw a gap where the deploy SA needs cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt on the key ring. I can add a scoped IAM binding instead of broad roles/cloudkms.admin.
devon: Important: audit logs from last week show 3 token uses from a stale CI job. Need to ensure audit logs capture KMS decrypt principal and pod identity.
lisa: Do we have a sample K8s RoleBinding patch? want to review before approving.
maria: Paste of the RBAC snippet I'm planning to apply (will run dry-run first):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gpu-deploy-minimal
  namespace: gpu-pool
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods/exec","pods/log"]
  verbs: ["get","list"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["patch","get"]
```
and binding to `deploy-sa@gke-prod`.
ajay: For KMS, I'd rather use a separate service account key: allow `projects/*/serviceAccounts/deploy-kms@` to call `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt`. attach via Workload Identity to the k8s SA.
rohit_oncall: FYI — if the RBAC change blocks the nightly canary, page me. I can flip a temp allow while we patch CI jobs.
devon: Also flag: our audit pipeline currently drops some `system:serviceaccount` fields in ingest. That makes it hard to tie decrypt events to k8s pods.
lisa: Who owns the audit ingestion fix? I can pick it up if no one else.
maria: @lisa please take ingestion fix. Steps: (1) update logstash parser to keep `protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail` and `resource.labels.pod_name`, (2) add an enrichment join on pod UID to node metadata.
lisa: taking it. ETA EOD Thursday.
sec-bot: [alert] Detected service-account usage from `ci-old-job` in gpu-pool at 2025-03-12T03:14:21Z — recommended: rotate SA and remove cluster-scoped bindings.
ajay: For deploy flow, plan to: (A) add KMS decrypt permission to a deploy-kms SA, (B) bind k8s deploy SA to that via Workload Identity, (C) revoke old cluster-admin RoleBinding from `ci-bot`.
devon: Can we also gate by namespace annotation + OPA/Gatekeeper constraint? want explicit opt-in for any SA that gets KMS unwrap.
maria: Yes — I'll add a Gatekeeper constraint that requires `allowedKmsAccess: true` annotation on namespaces. Gatekeeper will deny RoleBindings if SA tries to access KMS and annotation missing.
rohit_oncall: Good — once you have the Gatekeeper policy, I'll add it to the canary to verify no false denies.
lisa: Quick ask: any runbook updates? we should document rollback steps if jobs start failing after the change.
maria: Runbook draft: 
- If pods fail to start with KMS permission errors -> revert RoleBinding (kubectl apply -f revert-rbac.yaml) and notify oncall.
- If decrypt errors appear in logs -> check Workload Identity binding & KMS IAM.
- Temporary mitigation -> map deploy SA to a short-lived service account token via oncall approval.

ajay: I'll produce the `revert-rbac.yaml` and a readme for the Workload Identity mapping by EOD.
maria: Plan: land dry-run at 09:45 PT, apply at 10:00 PT, monitor 30m. If no regression, progress to remaining gpu-namespaces next week.
rohit_oncall: I'll be on standby during the window. Ping me in #eng-oncall if anything spikes. :thumbsup: 
sec-bot: [info] Scheduled RBAC update for gpu-pool namespace at 2025-03-18T17:00:00Z by maria.
